_comment: Filter pipe parsing cases, run by filter_sync_test.go and by frontend/src/lib/templateFilters.test.ts, so the editor reads a pipe exactly as a send does. pipe: false means the name is not a pipe at all; error is the Problem.Message of an invalid pipe.

cases.name: a |
cases.error: a filter name is missing after a |

cases.name: | base64
cases.error: a variable or a quoted text must come before the first |

cases.name: "a" b | base64
cases.error: the quoted text before the first | is not closed or has text after it

cases.name: a | sha1 hex x
cases.error: sha1 takes at most an output encoding

cases.name: a | sha1 b32
cases.error: sha1: the output encoding "b32" is not hex, base64 or base64url

cases.name: a | hmacSha1
cases.error: hmacSha1 needs a key: a variable name or a quoted text

cases.name: a | hmacSha1 k hex x
cases.error: hmacSha1 takes a key and at most an output encoding

cases.name: a | hmacSha1 "k"x
cases.error: the filter "hmacSha1 \"k\"x" has a quote that is not closed or text right after a quote
